summary: Clearwater NF lookout: 1925 log cabin, towers 1928, 1935 and 1950; destroyed 1972; drive-up site, no source describes it now.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a 41-foot treated timber tower (1950); earlier log cabin and 60-foot platform tower
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1972 per firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts. Rex's Fire Lookout Page lists it as removed, with no date, and says it was still in use in 1966. No source describes the site now.

access.note: Idaho Fire Lookouts marks the site drive-up. Rex's page says the point is on state land. No source describes current access.

events.note: Log cabin built as lookout quarters by Ranger Jack Parsell of the Middlefork District, per a 1981 Hartig history quoted on Rex's page.
40-foot tower with observatory built at about the same time, per Rex's page.
Went to the Nezperce Forest when the Selway was split up in 1934-35, per Rex's page.
Cabin and tower manned seasonally until 1946, per Hartig via Rex's page.
41-foot treated timber L-4 tower. Rex's page dates the replacement to 1946.
Came to the Lochsa District by boundary adjustment, per Rex's page.
Still in use in 1966, per Rex's page.
Destroyed, per firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1950 on firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Forest Service list; 1946 on Rex's page, which quotes Hartig's 1981 history. The story reports both.

Firelookout.com and the Forest Service list give a 60-foot platform tower in 1928 after the 1925 cabin. Rex's page describes a 40-foot tower with observatory at about 1925 and no 1928 platform tower. Both accounts are kept.
Destroyed in 1972 on firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts; listed as removed, undated, on Rex's page. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: The sources agree on the 1925 cabin and the 1972 loss but not on the tower sequence: 1946 vs 1950 for the 41-foot tower, and a 40-foot 1925 tower vs a 60-foot 1928 platform tower. Rex's page says state land, which may conflict with the Clearwater National Forest agency in the brief; access is set to unknown for that reason. The Rex page's undated removed status is kept alongside the 1972 destruction. The height_m of 12.5 is the 1950 tower only.
